entities.name: Mercedes Marcó del Pont
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mercedes Marcó del Pont is an Argentine economist and politician who was President of the Central Bank of Argentina. She has also served as a member of the National Chamber of Deputies, as head of the Federal Public Income Administration, and as Secretary of Strategic Affairs in the Presidency of Argentina under Alberto Fernandez.
